title: Film programme subway poster
slide_intent: Distinguish promotional voice from supporting information, because a busy setting requires a strong first read and a useful second read.
strategic_value: The large MoMA signature and pale vertical FILM lettering can create recognition while compact programme copy supplies detail.
demonstration: A framed subway poster pairs a blue-suited performer with a vertical MoMA signature, pale FILM lettering and small black and magenta programme text.
practical_value: Evaluate how title, signature and secondary copy compete with a large figure in an installed poster.

content_islands.name: Programme text
content_islands.spec: Place the compact programme list above the performer and the magenta secondary copy at the upper right.

content_islands.name: Figure and lettering
content_islands.spec: Keep the blue-suited figure prominent at left, with pale vertical FILM lettering beside the black MoMA signature.

content_islands.name: Installed frame
content_islands.spec: Retain the black frame, tiled wall and partial neighboring poster to show the viewing context.

reference_purposes.Expression: Heavy black MoMA type and pale oversized FILM lettering sit beside a photographic figure.
reference_purposes.Application: The framed poster is shown installed against subway tiles.
